comparison_and_counterexample: The relevant counterexample is the native layout of the same node, which places N at slot 8 (N_minus_C = +0.0927, best donor A:VAL:116:N at strength 0.854) and C at slot 20 (N_minus_C = -0.368, best donor A:VAL:116:N at strength 1.79e-06). L070 instead keeps N at 0 and 16 and makes slot 8 C. The finite N-minus-C contrasts are small and mixed in sign: slot 0 is +0.120, slot 16 is +0.444, slot 20 is -0.368, and slot 8 is +0.093. These are conditional associations with compensating labels elsewhere, not independent atom energies, and proximity alone or total N count cannot establish a transferable high-affinity rule. The prior feedback rounds are also cautionary: R01 (L036, 4 points, type weight 0) gave best_qualified_pic50 8.0278 with local_NC_identity_accuracy 0.958; R02 (L036, type weight 0.15) gave 8.0279 with identity accuracy 0.979; R03 (L036, type weight 0.4) gave 8.1281 with identity accuracy 0.938; R04 (L093, endpoint 0.4/type 0.3) gave 8.1289 but identity accuracy fell to 0.375 and one molecule failed qualification; R05 (L008) gave 8.0272; R06 (L036, orientation 0.15) gave 8.1272; R07 (L093) repeated 8.1289 with identity accuracy 0.375. None of these exceeded the R13_reference incumbent best_qualified_pic50 of 8.3780, and the R13 reference itself had local_NC_identity_accuracy 0.979 with 24/24 qualified. So reduced imitation loss or a higher target score is not success; the actual terminal affinity and structural quality must be compared. The best-legal counterfactual targets have not been regenerated or relaxed, so I do not claim they are observed successful paths.
expected_NC_and_geometry_response: With the frozen contract (endpoint 0.4, half 0.3, orientation 0.0, type 0.3, full_ce, unit_rms, window [0.1,0.5], max_atom_step 0.15 A, max_cumulative_rms 6.0 A, native_rms_ratio 0.33, pointcloud_delta 1.0 A), the deterministic tool will expand the typed N/C targets at slots 0, 16 and 20 and the neighboring context at slots 1, 7, 12, 13. All atom_slots, including context neighbors, receive direct geometry loss when a geometry term is enabled; only typed_slots receive type loss. Points outside atom_slots lack direct geometry loss and remain free, though model-mediated gradients can still affect them. I expect the local N/C response to be measured as identity accuracy at the typed sites and as local geometry RMS, with the type weight of 0.3 providing a nonzero but not dominant type signal. Because the type weight is nonzero, identity preservation is an outcome to measure, not an operation enforced by the geometry-only reward. I expect the two N destinations to remain near the ASP175 and VAL116 backbone N regions and the compensating C at slot 20 to remain near the VAL116 region, but I do not expect the geometry-only reward to guarantee that the N/C identities are preserved.
falsifier: Prospective falsifier: run the frozen L070 contract and compare against the frozen R13_reference control. If the qualified final pIC50 does not exceed the R13_reference best_qualified_pic50 of 8.3780, or if local_NC_identity_accuracy at the typed sites falls below the R13_reference value of 0.979, or if the number of qualified molecules drops below 24/24, then the hypothesis that this disconnected two-N-site relocation improves affinity while preserving the pyridine-type N/C identities is falsified. A further falsifier is that the measured local geometry RMS at the typed sites exceeds the R13_reference final_local_geometry_rms_A of 0.507 A, indicating that the N relocation is not geometrically supported. If no supported patch meets the intervention, defer without inventing evidence.
